items.title: Benchmark indices fall amid rising crude oil prices and West Asia conflict
items.description: India's benchmark indices ended lower on Wednesday, as crude oil prices increased. The Nifty50 and Sensex experienced significant drops, falling below key levels. Midcap and smallcap stocks also saw declines, reflecting broad market weakness. Most sector indices ended in negative territory, except for FMCG and Auto. Brent crude oil prices rose, impacting investor sentiment across the market.

items.title: Stocks in news: Infosys, IndusInd Bank, Eternal, Adani Green, Dr Reddy's
items.description: Indian markets experienced a decline on Wednesday due to global and geopolitical concerns. IndusInd Bank reported a significant profit increase while Eternal saw substantial net profit growth. BPCL, however, posted a considerable loss in the first quarter. Adani Green announced a moderate profit rise, and Dr Reddy's profit declined. Several other companies like Infosys will announce their first quarter results today.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Domestic equities declined as broad-based selling persisted across sectors. India VIX surged, reflecting heightened market volatility and investor fear. Analysts expect sideways trading with a negative bias due to global tensions. Foreign portfolio investors were net sellers, impacting market sentiment negatively. The Indian rupee fell to a two-month low as oil prices climbed.

items.title: Pharma stocks slide as Trump's 100% generic drug tariff plan spooks investors
items.description: Indian drug shares declined Wednesday following US President Trump's tariff announcement.  These proposed tariffs will significantly impact companies with substantial US revenue exposure.  Analysts suggest investors should now focus on domestically oriented Indian pharmaceutical firms.  The Nifty Pharma index saw a notable decrease, while the benchmark Nifty 50 also fell.  Negotiations are expected given India's vital role in supplying affordable medicines to the US.

items.title: Mauritius tax protocol to give Indian taxman more powers to probe offshore entities
items.description: Mauritius cabinet ratified a tax protocol granting Indian officials more questioning powers.  This allows direct challenges to offshore entities suspected of tax evasion.  The principal purpose test will deny treaty benefits if tax avoidance is a primary aim.  This change follows the Tiger Global verdict and strengthens genuine substance requirements.  The protocol aims to ensure treaty benefits are for legitimate commercial purposes.

items.title: External sectors steady despite geopolitical uncertainties: RBI
items.description: India's external sector shows steady improvement, boosted by foreign investment inflows.  The economy remains strong despite global uncertainties and trade disruptions.  Foreign exchange reserves provide ample cover for imports and external debt.  Exports and imports saw strong growth in the first quarter of this fiscal year.  Bilateral trade agreements will further enhance India's external trade momentum.

items.title: Up to 451% return in 6 months! 11 smallcap stocks turn multibaggers as FIIs raise stakes for 2 straight quarters
items.description: 11 smallcaps have at least doubled in six months, led by Sterlite Technologies' 451% jump, as FIIs raised stakes across the March and June 2026 quarters. The parallel rise signals selective conviction, but analysts warn the sharp rerating leaves little room for earnings misses.

items.title: Dr Reddy’s shares crack 9% after weak Q1; these 3 brokerages slash their target prices
items.description: Dr Reddy’s shares plunged 9% on Thursday after the drugmaker reported a weak Q1 FY27 performance, with net profit tumbling 69% year-on-year to Rs 443 crore and revenue declining 6% to Rs 8,071 crore. Earnings were hit by a Rs 240 crore semaglutide API-related impact, including inventory provisions, while higher solvent and freight costs due to the Middle East conflict further squeezed EBITDA margins.

items.title: 12 stocks that Goldman Sachs, Axis, InCred Equities are bullish on. Here’s the full list
items.description: With the Nifty50 down 8% in 2026 amid the Iran war and elevated oil prices, these 12 large, mid and small cap stocks have emerged as picks from three leading brokerage firms. Here’s what investors should know.

items.title: Eternal shares jump 3% after Q1 results. Jefferies, CLSA and 4 other brokerages weigh in
items.description: Shares of Eternal climbed 3% after its Q1FY27 earnings, with brokerages reaffirming bullish views on the stock. JPMorgan, CLSA, Jefferies, Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Emkay retained positive ratings, citing accelerating growth in food delivery and Blinkit, improving quick commerce profitability, stronger margin guidance and management's confidence that competitive intensity has become more predictable.

items.title: IndusInd Bank shares fall 5% despite 72% YoY Q1 profit surge. Why analysts remain bullish?
items.description: IndusInd Bank shares fell despite reporting a 72% year-on-year jump in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 1,037 crore and brokerages raising target prices. Investors remained cautious as net interest income stayed largely flat at Rs 4,685 crore. The lender's profitability was supported by an improvement in net interest margin to 3.57%.

items.title: Sensex drops over 300 points, Nifty below 23,950 as market falls for 4th day on rising Iran-US tensions. What’s ahead?
items.description: Indian stock markets extended losses for a fourth session on Thursday. Sensex and Nifty declined as oil prices surged following US strikes on Iran. Broader market indices also saw a downward trend, with several sectors opening in the red. Escalating tensions pushed Brent crude futures above ninety-six dollars per barrel. This situation presents opportunities for long-term investors to accumulate quality stocks.

items.title: Sotefin Bharat shares set for BSE SME debut today. GMP signals muted listing
items.description: Sotefin Bharat is set to debut on the BSE SME platform on July 23, with grey market premium (GMP) trends indicating a largely flat listing. Despite subdued GMP, the Rs 89.76-crore IPO was subscribed 3.78 times overall, backed by healthy participation across investor categories. The company plans to use the IPO proceeds to expand manufacturing capacity, strengthen operations, and meet working capital needs.

items.title: Oracle Financial Services shares jump 5% on strong Q1 results; PAT soars 121%, revenue up 69%
items.description: Oracle Financial Services Software shares rose 5% on Thursday. The company reported a 121% year-on-year net income increase. Revenue from operations also saw a substantial 69% jump. New agreements with major global financial institutions were highlighted. Management attributed success to AI-first strategy and product modernization.

items.title: Emami among 4 stocks closed above VWAP, signalling bullish shift
items.description: On July 22, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied more than 1% above their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP), according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A move above the VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, as it indicates that the stock is trading above its average price for the session after accounting for trading volumes.When the closing price rises above the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is higher than the average price at which the stock was traded throughout the day, with the average weighted by trading volume. Traders and investors often interpret this as a bullish signal, reflecting positive market sentiment and the possibility of continued upward momentum.

items.title: Data Patterns among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 22, four stocks from the Nifty500 segment that gained over 2% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels. “RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy Bharti Airtel, Hero MotoCorp, among 43 stocks for dividend payout worth Rs 1,127
items.description: As per Sebi's T+1 settlement cycle, investors must buy a company's shares at least one trading day before the record date to ensure the shares are credited to their demat accounts in time, and they become eligible for the corporate action

items.title: Negative Breakout: These 15 stocks cross below their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 15 stocks' closing prices crossed below their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on July 22, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Trading below the 200 DMA is considered a negative signal because it indicates that the stock's price is below its long-term trend line. The 200 DMA is a key indicator traders use to determine the overall trend in a particular stock. Take a look:

items.title: F&O Radar: Bull Call Spread strategy for Bajaj Auto this week
items.description: Bajaj Auto has broken out above a key descending trendline, signalling renewed bullish momentum. Technical indicators remain supportive, with the stock trading above major moving averages and RSI staying strong. Analysts recommend a Bull Call Spread strategy, targeting further upside while limiting downside risk through defined option positions.

items.title: NTPC Green shares soar 9% after Q1 earnings. What’s boosting investor sentiment?
items.description: NTPC Green Energy shares rose sharply on Thursday after the company reported strong Q1 FY27 earnings, with net profit rising 38% and revenue surging 63% year-on-year. Investor sentiment was further boosted by the board's approval to increase its stake in a joint venture, strengthening its renewable energy portfolio.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares slide 10% in four days after Q1 results but brokerages see up to 40% upside. Here’s why
items.description: HDFC Bank shares have fallen nearly 10% in four sessions since its Q1 FY27 results despite reporting steady earnings growth. Brokerages remain bullish, citing improving margins, healthy loan growth, lower credit costs and attractive valuations, with target prices implying upside potential of up to 40% from current levels.

items.title: BlackRock, Prashant Jain-backed 3P India among others invest in Indo MIM IPO anchor book of Rs 1,141 crore
items.description: Indo MIM has raised Rs 1,141 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 3,811 crore IPO, drawing participation from global institutions including BlackRock and domestic investors such as Prashant Jain-backed 3P India. More than half of the anchor allocation went to domestic mutual funds, reflecting strong institutional interest in the precision engineering manufacturer.

items.title: Waaree Renewable shares slide 7% despite 34% YoY surge in Q1 profit. What's spooking investors?
items.description: Waaree Renewable shares fell sharply on Thursday despite reporting a 34% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 profit, as investors focused on weaker sequential earnings and revenue. While the company remains optimistic about long-term growth, backed by a strong order book and T&D expansion, the Street appeared disappointed by the quarter-on-quarter slowdown.

items.title: MTF risk grows as investors borrow record Rs 1.36 lakh crore to buy stocks. What happens if the market falls?
items.description: Indian investors have borrowed a record Rs 1.36 lakh crore through Margin Trading Facility (MTF), even as cash market activity slows. While growing retail participation supports long-term expansion, rising leverage could amplify risks if markets correct, with volatility, margin calls and geopolitical uncertainty posing key challenges for leveraged investors.

items.title: Tanla Platforms shares jump nearly 14% post Q1 earnings, revenue surges 17.8% YoY
items.description: Tanla Platforms shares surged nearly 14% after Q1 FY27 revenue rose 17.8% year-on-year to Rs 1,226 crore. Strong gross profit, EBITDA and EPS growth reflected improving profitability, while higher spending by existing enterprise customers supported revenue momentum.

items.title: Adani Green shares tumble 5% after Q1 results. Here’s why Bernstein has an Underperform rating
items.description: Adani Green Energy shares fell on Thursday despite reporting a strong Q1 FY27 performance, with consolidated net profit rising 19% year-on-year to Rs 845 crore and revenue increasing 16% to Rs 4,663 crore. Revenue from power supply jumped 29%, supported by robust operational performance and a 27% increase in operational capacity to 20,142 MW.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold? Goldman Sachs maintains a buy on Eternal; Citi recommends sell rating on Dr Reddy’s Laboratories post Q1 results
items.description: Goldman Sachs and Citi have issued fresh post-Q1 calls on three stocks. Goldman stays bullish on Eternal (Buy, target Rs 345, 21% upside) due to Blinkit's margin gains. Citi holds a Buy on JSW Energy (target Rs 650) despite EBITDA missing estimates, but maintains a Sell on Dr Reddy's, cutting the target to Rs 1,040 after a 69% profit fall.

items.title: Bluestone Jewellery shares rocket 36% in just three days after Q1 results. Can the momentum sustain?
items.description: BlueStone Jewellery shares have surged 36% in three trading sessions after the company's strong Q1 results, which marked a return to profitability and robust revenue growth. Brokerages remain optimistic on the stock, citing aggressive store expansion, improving operating leverage and healthy long-term demand supported by the organised jewellery retail market.

items.title: Radhakishan Damani picks up 2% stake in this NBFC stock, which fell 17% in 2026. Do you own it?
items.description: Billionaire Radhakishan Damani and his family have re-entered Sundaram Finance with a 2.37% stake in the June quarter through Bright Star Investments, after previously exiting the holding in FY26, according to the company's latest shareholding pattern.

items.title: For investors who understand that it may get worse before it gets better: 5 large-caps with upside potential of up to 31%
items.description: The noise levels are currently high in the markets. And, at this point of time, it seems there is literally nothing positive about them. From crude prices, to tariffs, to the monsoon – everything appears gloomy. These are not perfect conditions to buy stocks; but then, in perfect conditions, stocks also tend to be more expensive. So, pick between perfect conditions and good stock prices. If you are someone who sees this as an opportunity, the obvious question is: Which stocks? You will make the right decision if you look at businesses rather than at stock prices.

items.title: Domino effect: Gandhar Oil’s 20% upper circuit spurs rally in Savita Oil and Panama Petro. Here’s why
items.description: Gandhar Oil Refinery hit the 20% upper circuit after reporting a 689% year-on-year jump in Q1 net profit, triggering a rally in peers Savita Oil and Panama Petrochem. Strong demand across PHPO, PIO and lubricants, along with expanding exports and higher-margin products, boosted investor sentiment.

items.title: Bonus bonanza! This textile player announced 1:1 bonus issue, dividend just 14 sessions after market debut. Do you own?
items.description: Aastha Spintex approved a 1:1 bonus issue and Re 0.10 final dividend for FY26, subject to shareholder approval. The microcap textile firm also cleared plans to expand into grey fabric manufacturing, even as its shares remain below the IPO price after listing.

items.title: Rekha Jhunjhunwala sells over 7 crore Star Health shares in Q1. Details here
items.description: Ace investor Rekha Jhunjhunwala sharply cut her promoter stake in Star Health to 3.04% from 15.57% during the June quarter of FY27, implying a sale of nearly 7.38 crore shares. The latest shareholding pattern also showed the promoter holding under Rakesh Jhunjhunwala and Associates fell to nil. Star Health is a Chennai-based health insurer.

items.title: Market wrap: Adani Enterprises, IndiGo, Bajaj Auto among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
items.description: Indian benchmark indices extended losses for a fourth straight session as rising oil prices, driven by escalating US-Iran tensions, weighed on sentiment. Analysts warned of inflation risks, weaker market momentum and continued volatility, with Nifty facing resistance near the 24,000 level.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A wealth manager for a 6% gain, a large-cap auto maker’s stock for a rise of 7%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: ITC charts growth strategy as cigarette tax hike hits stock
items.description: ITC Chairman Sanjiv Puri said the company is tackling higher cigarette taxes through calibrated price hikes, product innovation and diversification. ITC will invest Rs 20,000 crore over five years, strengthen FMCG operations and consider an ITC Infotech IPO after achieving scale.

items.title: Weekly Top Picks: These stocks scored 10 on 10 on Stock Reports Plus
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, undertakes detailed company analysis for 4,000+ listed stocks. In addition to detailed company analyses, the report also collates analysts’ forecasts and trend analysis for each component. An average score in Stock Reports Plus is calculated by undertaking quantitative analysis of five key investment tools – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum.

items.title: Sebi proposes allowing portfolio managers to invest overseas, in to-be-listed securities
items.description: India's markets regulator is looking to simplify compliance requirements for portfolio managers, aiming to broaden investment options to encompass overseas securities and unlisted debt. A novel group of portfolio managers will focus on high-net-worth individuals with reduced entry thresholds. The initiative also seeks to enhance the application of derivatives strategies for clients. Stakeholders are encouraged to provide feedback on these proposals by August 13th.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
items.description: Sensex and Nifty declined for a fourth straight session as surging crude oil prices and escalating US-Iran tensions dampened investor sentiment. Analysts flagged rising inflation risks, bearish technical indicators and continued market volatility, with Nifty likely to face resistance near the 24,000 mark.
